q2_gaps: A multi-word capitalized PLURAL proper name whose head word is a kind word ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools"): the multi-word-name rule licenses one ordinary type atom read off the kind word inside the name (its example, "the Kestrel River", is singular), while the capitalized-plural-label rule says a plural kind-word label referring as a name is Name-only with no GroupOf and no kind taken from the label word. The instruction set does not say which governs here, nor — if a type atom is licensed — whether a plural-referring name should be typed with the singular kind (Member <name> tide_pool) or by some plural-aware form.
notes: Statement 4 (sbtp_type) types the plural-referring name as a single tide_pool, which is the atom the boundary above decides; everything else — the every-rule with Skolem event and dependent sea-water witness, the entity-attached From of origin, the QuantifierPhrase companion, and the sea_water/tide_pool genus atoms — follows the instruction set.
